roadmap_scope: Current and goal Q rows, one continuous token each; all conditions have the same text graph and explicit current/goal IDs.

prompts.system: You are solving a task on a fixed, undirected, unweighted graph.

scoring.decision: Extract the explicit decision before graph scoring; unresolved outputs require separate semantic review.
scoring.successful_action: Any adjacent node with strictly smaller shortest-path distance to the goal.
scoring.accuracy_denominator: All 100 ordered test pairs per condition.

comparison: Within-item matched four conditions: frozen text baseline; selected report MLP; equal-budget report-only continuation; report-plus-action continuation. All use the exact existing full-text prompt and generation policy.
interpretation: Exploratory reuse of a fixed graph and previously inspected test pairs. The old action continuation was trained with hidden text IDs; this evaluates transfer to matched full-text augmentation. Compare action training chiefly to equal-budget report continuation. Additional vector tokens may affect completion as well as graph reasoning.
